note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). Four portal screens in DEV. The tenant is on the Low performance profile (trial licences, 10,000 actions per 24 hours): only the 1,000 item runs are recorded on the day (about 4,100 actions); never run the draft at 4,000 items for real and run no other flow of labadmin that day. Durations are whatever SharePoint throttling gives; nothing is edited.
prepare: # owner signs in: pac and Connect-PnPOnline below, and the browser profile for labadmin (make.powerautomate.com, SharePoint). Nothing is typed or stored here.
pac auth create --name dev --environment $env:DEV_URL   # owner signs in, off camera
# owner (tenant, demo.md Setup 1): IT Requests gets the Archived choice value and the DoneOn column; index Status and DoneOn

# owner (demo.md Setup 2-3): fill the environment variables (site URL, list IT Requests, cts_ArchiveAfterDays 30, mailbox), sign in the two connection references; build the draft flow 'Archive done IT requests (draft)' by hand from src\drafts; keep both flows off until the test
Connect-PnPOnline -Url $env:HELPDESK_SITE_URL -Interactive   # owner signs in (PnP app id from the owner's own registration)
# owner: between the three tuned runs (concurrency 1, 20, 50) re-seed with: .\scripts\Seed-ITRequests.ps1 -Cleanup; .\scripts\Seed-ITRequests.ps1 -Count 1000

screens.name: slowrun
steps: Select environment DEV and open the flow 'Archive done IT requests (draft)'
Run it once manually on the 1,000 item list and open the 28-day run history
Show Start time and Duration of the run (read the duration off the screen, do not edit it)
Open the run and expand 'Apply to each': 'Get item again' and the condition repeated for every item
mask: environment URL and ID in the address bar
tenant name and account in the top bar

screens.name: fastrun
steps: Open the tuned flow 'Archive done IT requests' and its run history
On the re-seeded list of the same size run it with Apply to each concurrency 1 (Settings on the loop), re-seed, then 20, re-seed, then 50
Show the three Duration values side by side in the run history
Open a run: 'Get done requests' returns only the done, old requests and 'Archive item' is the only action in the loop
mask: environment URL and ID in the address bar
tenant name and account in the top bar

screens.name: analytics
steps: Open the flow details page of the draft flow > Analytics > Actions tab
Do the same for the tuned flow, on the day of the test (Analytics can lag: wait and retake if it is empty)
Put a terminal with the dry-run numbers next to it: python -m perfkit compare drafts/slow-archive-done-requests.json solution/Workflows/*.json (run from src)
Show the real counts next to the dry-run counts; if they differ, the real ones stay
mask: environment URL and ID in the address bar
tenant name and account in the top bar

screens.name: listindex
steps: Open the list IT Requests > List settings > Indexed columns
Show the item count of the list above five thousand if the seed was raised that far
mask: tenant name in the address bar and the SharePoint header

teardown: # owner (SharePoint): empty the site's Recycle Bin (both stages); remove the Archived value, DoneOn and the two indexes if episode 1's list must go back to how it was
# owner (tenant): delete the draft flow and the IT Housekeeping solution from DEV; check that labadmin's Analytics shows no leftover runs; both flows stay off
